## Summary
A concise summary of the proposed addition, workflow step, or improvement.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this solve? Where do current AI coding agents fail or struggle that this would address?

## Proposed Guidance / Change
Describe the proposed rule, workflow change, reference document, or template addition.

## Real-world Example or Scenario
Provide a scenario showing when and how this guidance would be applied by an agent.

## Alternatives Considered
Any other alternatives or reasons why this shouldn't be handled differently.
